style: English psych folk funk, 100 BPM: a younger South London tenor-baritone carrying a Brixton lilt, laid-back and stoned-cool, unhurried, glottal stops and dropped H's, drawling the verses in sly half-sung patter, no rapping, a sly music-hall storyteller propped at the bar, slow and swaggering, then lifting into a bright, eager soulful melody with falsetto flicks for the hook, thrilled but never yelled, his pub pals singing the refrain back. Tin whistle out front, hand drums and congas, a rubbery slap-and-fuzz bass. Heavy psych funk: fuzz-wah guitar licks between lines, tape-saturated phased drums. Dubbed-out psych layers: spring-reverb guitar skanks, echo-chamber delay throws trailing off line endings. Soft cello drones under the verses; one operatic soprano, wordless high descant far back in the reverb, hooks and bridge only.
exclude: sitar, tabla, Indian, comedy, novelty, parody, kazoo, cartoon, trap, double-time, fast rap, autotune, EDM, country, smooth R&B, rap, hip hop, boom-bap, scratching, vocal chops, American accent, screaming, shouting, yelling, dancehall, ragga, toasting, reggaeton, full choir, soprano lead, operatic lead vocal, synth pads
lyrics:
[Intro: whistle melody from the first bar, phased kit and congas, slap bass bouncing, a fuzz-wah phrase replying]

[Verse One: lazy half-sung drawl, stoned and cool, voice right on the mic, low cello hum beneath, reverb-soaked guitar chops on the upbeats]
They say, ya can't make money from a tree
let's see, each day, make hay, not free, aay
work and get paid though, earning that dough
but where does it go? nobody knows!

means of production means a reduction
standards bleeding, land-lords needing
quantative easing, grandma FREEEEEEEZING!
stimulus checks are next. Get wrecked!

[Talked sideways, wry and deadpan, groove carries on underneath, final word repeats into the echo]
rent seeking?... I'm just about eating
sorry, did I interrupt your meeting?
remember kids, the Fed is not your friend!
it prints all the dollars that the government spends

[Build: drawl starting to brighten, wah guitar sneaking up, repeats piling higher]
this fiat system is insistent
on debts existence, sooooo
don't be hating on the credit rating
or have resistance to the facts I'm stating

[Hook: bright eager soul melody, little falsetto flicks, buzzing but never yelled, pub pals singing it back, faraway wordless soprano drifting high in the reverb]
Robbery, robbery!
Call the police, it's a robbery!
Debasement! Debasement! It happened in da basement!
Printer is burrrrrrrrring, now now what's occurrrrrrrring?

Robbery, robbery!
Call the police, it's a robbery!
Debasement! Debasement! It happened in da basement!
Printer is burrrrrrrrring, now now what's occurrrrrrrring?

[Verse Two: stripped to slap bass, congas and cello hum, lazy drawl, fuzz-wah stabs in the gaps, each line end dissolving into repeats]
Stacks and stacks of elastic cash
distracted by a dispraxic flash,
mob, angry at their shitty little job
the right and the left both witness the theft

blaming each other is a sick little cover
institutional, dilutional, the usual
distraction IS the attraction
the intention is tension between the factions

divide and conquer, just look at the hand
It's not ya standard, propaganda, worth a couple grand-ahh
it is, state, level, manipulation
it is the devil, with a radio station

[Build: half-sung climb, phaser sweeping the drums, reverb tank crash]
stack up the vaults like a wheelbarrow
risk of default is really rather narrow
Biggie said waaaay back in ninety seven
don't get high off your own supply

[Hook: bright eager soul melody, little falsetto flicks, pub pals singing it back, faraway wordless soprano drifting high in the reverb]
Robbery, robbery!
Call the police, it's a robbery!
Debasement! Debasement! It happened in da basement!
Printer is burrrrrrrrring, now now what's occurrrrrrrring?

Robbery, robbery!
Call the police, it's a robbery!
Debasement! Debasement! It happened in da basement!
Printer is burrrrrrrrring, now now what's occurrrrrrrring?

[Verse Three: cheeky stoned drawl, whistle replying in the gaps, cello hum deep and low]
You know the real star is Pablo Escobar,
who has elastic bands not plastic hands,
stacking up the cash by the grands
standard plans are for the working man

and this right here is a next level scam
ill gotten gains, no need to explain
"bail" and "out", will never mean the same
own the printer and you don't fear winter

[Bridge: steady ascent, fuzz-wah and phased kit thickening, wordless soprano hovering in the distance, reverb space widening]
crime is asset inflation, passive creation;
of a wealth gap that drives the situation
working people get paid in money, so it's not very funny
when you print more and expect them not to worry

[Last Hook: biggest bright soul finale, falsetto flicks, thrilled but never yelled, everyone in the pub singing along, slap-and-fuzz bass and congas flat out, soprano descant floating high and far]
hungry people, feed a revolution,
then it's retribution, perhaps some execution
it's time to give, not just to take
but for heaven’s sake, don't just eat cake

[Outro: whistle, slap bass and one more fuzz-wah phrase, last word fading through the echo]

[End]
title: brj-sr7-soprano-descant-wah-funk
